tagline: A practical playbook for showing up when Nigerian customers search for what you sell.
whatsInside: How to set up and actually optimize Google Business Profile for a Nigerian business
The handful of on-page SEO basics that matter most for a small site, in plain language
How local, Nigeria-specific search behaviour differs from generic SEO advice you'll find online
A monthly checklist to keep your visibility improving without hiring an agency
whoFor: Small business owners and solo founders in Nigeria who want customers to find them on Google without paying for ads or an SEO agency.

faq.q: Do I need a developer to do any of this?
faq.a: No. Everything in the guide is something a business owner can do themselves in an afternoon, with no code.

faq.q: Will this work if I don't have a website yet?
faq.a: Most of the biggest wins — Google Business Profile, reviews, local listings — don't require a website at all. It'll also tell you when a website starts to matter.

faq.q: How fast will I see results?
faq.a: Local search improvements usually show up in weeks, not months, once Google Business Profile is set up correctly — the guide explains why.
